title: BMS status frames delayed under high gateway bus load
symptoms: BMS_Pack cycle time jitter p99 increased, dropped frames, timing regression after gateway routing table change
root_cause: Gateway routing table moved BMS frames to a lower-priority transmit queue
resolution: Restore queue priority for safety-relevant battery frames

title: Inverter switching frequency calibration raises losses
symptoms: PackCurrent residual higher for same motor torque and speed, battery current increase, efficiency drop, inverter temperature slightly higher
root_cause: PWM switching frequency table changed in inverter calibration
resolution: Revert switching frequency map for mid-load region

title: Climate compressor refrigerant pressure sensor DTC after HVAC software update
symptoms: new DTC from HVAC after update, confirmed status, compressor pressure plausibility
root_cause: Plausibility window for pressure sensor tightened in new HVAC software
resolution: Widen plausibility window and clear latched DTC

title: Park lock engaged before standstill
symptoms: GearState Park while VehicleSpeed above zero, park engagement requires standstill rule violated, park pawl request at low speed
root_cause: Standstill debounce threshold changed from 0.5 km/h to 4 km/h in shift-by-wire logic
resolution: Restore standstill threshold; add speed interlock unit test

title: Infotainment cold boot slowed by new media indexing service
symptoms: IVI_Heartbeat first frame delayed after wake, startup latency increased, boot time regression, higher CPU load
root_cause: Media indexer started synchronously during early boot

title: Head unit CPU load elevated by map tile prefetch
symptoms: CpuLoad increased, CpuTemp increased, infotainment processor load higher across fleet
resolution: Add exponential backoff to prefetch loop

title: Rear-left wheel speed sensor intermittent signal
symptoms: WheelSpeed_RL noisy, dropouts to zero, wheel speed disagreement with reference speed on single vehicle, tail outliers
resolution: Replace sensor and harness; not an update regression

title: Cell voltage sag reported low due to BMS filter change
symptoms: CellVoltMin lower under load, PackVoltage residual shift

title: Wheel speed message missing after ABS reflash
symptoms: ABS_WheelSpeed dropped frames, missing message, startup delayed
root_cause: ABS bootloader left network management in silent mode
resolution: Fix NM state transition at end of flash

title: Motor temperature model offset after inverter software update
symptoms: MotorTemp residual shift, motor temperature higher for same load

title: Cabin temperature overshoot with new climate control gains
symptoms: CabinTemp residual, CompressorPower dispersion increased, oscillating compressor

title: Torque request and actual torque mismatch
symptoms: MotorTorqueReq residual shift, MotorTorqueAct differs from request, pedal map change
root_cause: Accelerator pedal map replaced with sport map in comfort mode

title: Inverter temperature sensor open circuit
symptoms: InverterTemp outliers, temperature spikes on one vehicle, tail rate increased

title: Battery current sensor offset drift
symptoms: PackCurrent residual offset on one vehicle at standstill
root_cause: Hall sensor offset drift with temperature

title: Diagnostic gateway floods bus with event frames
symptoms: DIAG_DTC burst, cycle time violations on other messages, bus load increase
resolution: Add inhibit time to DTC broadcast
